title: A linear relation between trace maps forces two surjections to agree

difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that if a nontrivial integer multiple of a sum of traces of algebra maps equals the difference of the traces of two surjective algebra maps, then the two surjections coincide (statement lines 3590-3603). The proof (proof lines 3604-3653) reduces to a finite separable algebra, extends scalars to an algebraic closure, and uses minimal idempotents together with the integrality of traces on idempotents. H3: a three stage reduction with an explicit contradiction, written out in full.
